text:
𝗡𝗭 𝟭𝟬𝟱/𝟱 𝗜𝗡 𝟯𝟳! 🇮🇳🔥

Bumrah has 3 wickets, including Latham for a duck, in the 1st Test at Wellington.
Nicholls is on 50*; Akash Deep and Kamboj got one each.

Can India finish NZ off today? 👇
#INDvNZ #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗭 𝟭𝟬𝟱/𝟱, 𝗕𝗨𝗠𝗥𝗔𝗛 𝗞𝗔 𝗞𝗔𝗛𝗔𝗥! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 Wellington Test ke Day 1 par NZ 37 overs mein 105/5
👉 Bumrah ne 3 wicket liye, Latham ko duck par bowled kiya
👉 Akash Deep aur Kamboj ko 1-1 wicket
👉 Henry Nicholls 50* par hain

Kya India NZ ko aaj hi sametega? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #Bumrah
